notes.title: Servers down for upgrades
notes.notes:
The Averon Rising game servers are currently inaccessible in order to reduce traffic for the upgrades being performed. This is following the successful tests of the empire systems with our closed alpha group. Our plans currently involve reopening the servers around August 15th 2020 to select groups for testing the new systems. If you would like to be involved in those tests please sign up as a patreon supporter and contact us on our discord.

https://www.patreon.com/AveronRising

https://discord.gg/pMk582k

Thank you for your patience! We look forward to seeing you on Averon!

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 1.0.0 closed test
notes.notes:
The closed pre-alpha test of the Averon Rising Empire system has just released. For those of you interested in being a part of this early test phase you only need to have been a patreon supporter at any point to receive an access code. 

If you have yet to support the project on patreon it's not too late to get access:

https://www.patreon.com/AveronRising

If you are already a supporter but have not signed up for the closed pre-alpha test, join the discord channel:

https://discord.gg/pMk582k

Then ask the admins to add you to the testing group.

notes.title: Want in on Averon Rising before anyone else?
notes.notes:
Averon has been live on our website for more than a year. However, the game has outgrown the browser! We're moving to a stand-alone client here on Steam. If you want in on the pre-alpha game and to give input on its development check out:

https://www.patreon.com/AveronRising

All levels of patreon support get a steam key to access the game in its early stages!

If you want to join the development discussion also check out our discord and facebook page:

https://discord.gg/pMk582k

https://www.facebook.com/Averon-Rising-735709333454819

Thanks for checking out Averon Rising!
